test_title: PYST 12: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seven colleagues of different ages. T is immediately younger than P but older than only S and U. Q is not the oldest. V is immediately older than P. Who amongst the seven colleagues is the oldest?
solution:
From the given figure:

Step 1: T is immediately younger than P but older than only S and U.

_ > _ > _ > P > T > S \ U 

Step 2: V is immediately older than P.

_ > _ > V > P > T > S
